summary: Iteration 3 testing complete. All 18 backend tests pass (13 new in test_decor_rotation.py + 5 regression in test_houses_zones.py). Frontend E2E verified: create room, Build House, walk-UP into door enters house, Decorate panel opens for owner, floor-mint + wall-lavender applied, select bed (slot 9), rotate shows 90°, press E places bed, select plant (slot 12), press E places plant, walk-DOWN onto EXIT mat transitions back to island with player spawned at (house.x, house.y+70) — exactly the spawn-in-front logic. Non-owner (Bob) joining Alice's house correctly has NO Decorate button but sees interior-banner. All features working as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: IslandGame.jsx is ~987 lines — approaching the >700 line threshold; consider splitting rendering (drawInterior/drawItem/drawIsland) and keyboard/game-loop hooks into separate modules for maintainability.

set_decor validation only truncates to 16 chars but does not whitelist allowed values (wood/pink/mint/stone, cream/mint/blue/lavender). A client could persist arbitrary strings; frontend would then fall back to defaults in drawInterior. Low-severity but a good server-side allowlist would harden it.

WS place handler accepts any integer rotation — spec says 0/90/180/270 only. No server-side normalization/validation; values like 45 or 999 would persist. Consider `rotation = int(data.get('rotation', 0)) % 360` and/or enum check.

Minor: pydantic PlacedItem has rotation: int = 0 but server does int(data.get('rotation',0)) before building the model — rotation=90 works but a non-integer string would raise ValueError inside the WS handler and silently log. Add try/except or coerce safely.
test_credentials: N/A (no auth; join by name + room code)
seed_data_creation: Each pytest test creates a fresh room via POST /api/rooms/create; data prefixed with TEST_
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend WS features (set_decor owner-only + persistence + zone-isolated broadcast, build_house decor defaults wood/cream, rotation persistence for 0/90/180/270, new furniture types bed/rug/bookshelf/plant, island spawn-in-front at house.x/house.y+70 after exit, set_decor-from-island-ignored) are all covered in /app/backend/tests/test_decor_rotation.py. Regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_houses_zones.py still green. Frontend door walk-through: use repeated page.keyboard.press('w'/'s') with small waits (10ms between) rather than keyboard.down/up — the latter can race the transitionLock cooldown in headless Playwright.
